blocks.title: Online check-in opens - Alaska 316
blocks.detail:
• Check in all 4 in the Alaska app (opens 24 hrs before departure)
• Mobile boarding passes; bag tags printed at the MIA kiosk

blocks.title: Kids' bedtime routine
blocks.detail:
• Lights out 5:50 PM = 10 hrs before the 3:50 AM wake-up
• Bags packed and by the door before bedtime

blocks.title: Wake up & get ready
blocks.detail: • 1 hr to dress and load the bags

blocks.title: Ride to MIA - drop-off at departures
blocks.detail:
• Drop-off at Door 13 on the departures level (Alaska counters 211-214, Concourse E) - no parking needed
• Early Monday - light traffic; ride time is an estimate from home

blocks.title: Alaska check-in & bag drop
blocks.detail:
• Bag drop closes 40 min before departure (7:01 AM)
• Holiday-week Monday - expect lines

blocks.title: TSA security (Concourse E)
blocks.detail:
• 5-8 AM is MIA's peak security window
• 30 min budgeted for a family of four

blocks.title: Breakfast - Starbucks (Concourse E)
blocks.detail:
• Post-security in Concourse E, Alaska's concourse
• Breakfast sandwiches, egg bites, oatmeal; hot chocolate for the kids
• Refill water bottles before heading to the gate
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE: 2 adult drinks + 2 breakfast sandwiches + 2 kids' hot chocolates + 2 kids' food items, about $55 at airport prices. Airport menus and hours aren't posted; check the Starbucks or MIA app the morning of.

blocks.title: Walk to the gate & restrooms
blocks.detail: • Gate is posted on the boarding pass / Alaska app the day of

blocks.title: At the gate - boarding
blocks.detail:
• Boarding starts about 35-40 min before departure
• Families can pre-board

blocks.title: Alaska 316 - MIA → SEA - nonstop 6h52m
blocks.detail:
• Boeing 737 MAX 9, Economy
• Lands 11:33 AM Pacific (2:33 PM Miami time)
• Main cabin food is for purchase - snacks and soft drinks are free
• Packed lunch from home before landing
blocks.notes: Booked. 12,500 Atmos points + $5.60 per person x 4 = 50,000 points + $22.40; taxes paid with the BofA Atmos Ascent card ending 1029. Add each traveler's Atmos number to the reservation.

blocks.title: Deplane & walk to baggage claim
blocks.detail:
• Families rarely deplane first
• If arriving at an N gate, take the SEA Underground (trains every 3 min)

blocks.title: Baggage claim & restrooms
blocks.detail:
• Domestic arrival, no customs
• Alaska bags usually on the carousel within 20 min

blocks.title: To the Turo meeting spot
blocks.detail:
• Exact spot comes from the host in the Turo app
• Often an off-airport lot by shuttle, or the parking garage

blocks.title: Turo pickup - 8 days
blocks.detail:
• Walk-around photos in the app
• Load luggage, install 2 car seats
• Check tire sidewalls for M+S or snowflake symbol
blocks.notes: Estimate: ~$570 for 8 days, return Dec 29. Confirm whether child seats are included.
blocks.flag: Get written OK from the host to drive into Canada, plus Canada insurance coverage and winter-rated (M+S or snowflake) tires for the Sea-to-Sky.

blocks.title: Drive SEA → Hyatt Regency Seattle
blocks.detail:
• ~14 mi via I-5 to 808 Howell St
• About 25 min on a Saturday midday + buffer

blocks.title: Arrive Hyatt Regency Seattle - park & check in
blocks.detail:
• Hotel garage (no valet)
• Ask for early check-in; bell desk holds bags if the room isn't ready
• Regency Club (8th floor) open to Globalists
blocks.notes: Booked under Jennifer Borges: Regency Suite via Suite Upgrade Award, 15,000 points/night (Category 5) = 30,000 points, 2 adults + 2 children. Globalist: breakfast at Andare buffet, Regency Club access, free parking on award stays. The confirmation shows a $29/night destination fee for bookings from June 1, 2026 - usually waived on award stays; confirm at check-in.
blocks.flag: Official check-in is 4:00 PM - ask for early check-in; the bell desk can hold bags.

blocks.title: Settle in & get ready
blocks.detail:
• Showers, change, unpack basics
• If the room isn't ready: freshen up in the Regency Club

blocks.title: Walk to Westlake Center
blocks.detail:
• ~0.4 mi to 400 Pine St
• Monorail station is on the 3rd floor

blocks.title: Monorail to Seattle Center
blocks.detail:
• ~2-min ride; trains about every 10 min
• Pay at the station or tap a card
blocks.notes: One way: 2 adults x $4 + 1 youth (6-18) x $2 + 1 child (5 & under) free = $10. Fares effective Jan 1, 2025.

blocks.title: Seattle Christmas Market
blocks.detail:
• Fisher Pavilion block at the foot of the Space Needle
• Christmas carousel, walk-through tree, daily snow showers, Santa photos
• Heated Alpen Haus for warming up
• Lights come on around sunset (~4:20 PM) with the Space Needle lit overhead
blocks.notes: Family Season Pass $64.99 covers 2 adults + 2 youth; kids 6 and under always free; no timeslot booking needed. Single-day alternative: adult $23.59 for a Dec 21 afternoon slot; youth (7-14) discounted rate shown at checkout. Prices from the official ticket site, Oct 2026. Carousel may cost extra.
blocks.flag: Dec 19-23 are the busiest days - buy ahead.

blocks.title: Winterfest train & village (Armory)
blocks.detail:
• Model train and holiday village inside the Armory
• Free; $2 suggested donation to run the train
• Open daily 10 AM-6 PM Nov 27-Dec 31

blocks.title: Monorail back to Westlake
blocks.notes: Same fare as the ride out: $10 for the family.

blocks.title: Walk to Wild Ginger
blocks.detail: • ~0.5 mi north to 8th Ave & Blanchard

blocks.title: Dinner - Wild Ginger McKenzie
blocks.detail:
• 2202B 8th Ave; Pan-Asian, family style
• Kids' menu: chicken nuggets, egg noodles, chicken satay, fried rice
• Open Mon 4-8 PM - reserve the 5:00 table
blocks.notes: Kung Pao Chicken $24 + Seven Flavor Beef $30 (adults) + large jasmine rice $4.50 + Kids Wild Chicken Nuggets $4.50 + Kids Chicken Fried Rice $4 = $67.00. Water. + 10.35% tax ($6.93) + 20% tip ($13.40) = $87.33. Main menu dated 06.02.26; the kids' menu PDF is undated and its prices may have gone up (kids menu: https://www.wildginger.net/s/wgm_kids_menu-f5fh.pdf).

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • ~4 blocks down 8th Ave

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail:
• Lights out 7:15 PM Pacific = 10:15 PM on Miami body clocks
• Everyone has been up since 4 AM Eastern

blocks.title: Breakfast - Andare (hotel buffet)
blocks.detail:
• Lobby level, buffet 6:30-11:00 AM
• Globalist breakfast benefit
blocks.notes: Covered by Globalist breakfast. Confirm at check-in how it applies to the kids.

blocks.title: Coats, shoes, out the door
blocks.detail: • Rain jackets - December is Seattle's wettest month

blocks.title: Walk to Pike Place Market
blocks.detail: • 0.6 mi downhill, ~11 min at adult pace

blocks.title: Original Starbucks (1912 Pike Pl)
blocks.detail:
• The 1971 store with the original logo
• Line is usually shortest early in the morning
blocks.notes: Estimate: 2 adult drinks + 2 kids' hot chocolates. This location's own prices aren't posted online.

blocks.title: Pike Place Market walk-through
blocks.detail:
• Pike Place Fish Market - fish tossing at the main arcade
• Rachel the bronze pig, the neon Public Market clock
• Main Arcade stalls and the Down Under lower levels
• Post Alley & the Gum Wall
• Mornings before noon are the least crowded

blocks.title: Walk to Colman Dock (ferry terminal)
blocks.detail:
• Down the Overlook Walk to the waterfront
• 0.7 mi to Pier 52

blocks.title: Ferry terminal - tickets & boarding
blocks.detail:
• Walk-on fare paid in Seattle covers the round trip
• Walk-ons board about 10-15 min before sailing
blocks.notes: 2 adults x $11.35 round trip = $22.70. Ages 18 and under ride free. WSF fare as of Oct 2026.

blocks.title: 12:25 PM ferry to Bainbridge Island
blocks.detail:
• 35-min crossing, skyline views behind you
• Fall 2026 weekday schedule (valid Sep 20-Dec 26) - recheck sailing times on the WSF site before you go

blocks.title: Walk to Doc's Marina Grill
blocks.detail: • ~0.5 mi through Winslow

blocks.title: Lunch - Doc's Marina Grill
blocks.detail:
• On Eagle Harbor marina
• Burgers, sandwiches, fish & chips, kids' menu
• Open daily 10:45 AM-9:45 PM
blocks.notes: Big Doc Burger $22 + Chicken Cheddar Club $22 (adults) + Kids Chicken Strips $14 + Kids Grilled Cheese $10 (kids) = $68. Entrees only, water. + ~9.2% tax ($6.26) + 20% tip ($13.60) = $87.86. Prices from Doc's online menu, Oct 2026.

blocks.title: Stroll back to the ferry terminal
blocks.detail: • Waterfront Park path along the harbor

blocks.title: Board the return ferry
blocks.detail: • No fare collected on the Bainbridge side for walk-ons

blocks.title: 2:55 PM ferry back to Seattle
blocks.detail: • Best skyline views of the day on the way in

blocks.title: Walk to Pier 57
blocks.detail: • 0.3 mi along the new waterfront promenade

blocks.title: Seattle Great Wheel
blocks.detail:
• 175 ft, out over Elliott Bay
• Timed for sunset (~4:20 PM)
• Light shows run on weekend evenings
blocks.notes: 2 adults x $25 + 2 youth (3-11) x $18 = $86. Online price, Oct 2026; tickets are not date-specific.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• ~1.1 mi, mostly uphill
• A rideshare is ~10 min if the kids are done walking

blocks.title: Quick stop at the hotel
blocks.detail: • Restrooms, dry layers, grab the car

blocks.title: Drive to Ivar's Salmon House
blocks.detail: • ~3 mi to Lake Union's north shore

blocks.title: Dinner - Ivar's Salmon House
blocks.detail:
• Cedar longhouse on Lake Union
• Views of the lake and the downtown skyline lights
• Reserve ahead
blocks.notes: Cedar Plank Sockeye Salmon $44 + Seared Chicken Piccata $36 (adults) + 2x Grilled Cheese w/ fries ~$8.50 (kids) = $97. Entrees only, water. + 10.55% tax ($10.23) + 20% tip ($19.40) = $126.63. Adult prices from the current dinner menu; kids' price read from Ivar's kids menu PDF - treat as approximate.

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail: • Back by 8:00 PM keeps 10 hrs of sleep before the 7:00 AM wake-up

blocks.title: Breakfast - Andare (hotel buffet)
blocks.detail: • Globalist breakfast benefit

blocks.title: Check out & load the car
blocks.detail: • Passports for all 4 in the front-seat bag, not the trunk

blocks.title: Drive Seattle → Canadian border
blocks.detail:
• ~110 mi north on I-5, straight through
• Restroom stop if needed around Burlington or Bellingham
• Before Bellingham, check WSDOT border wait times

blocks.title: Border crossing into Canada
blocks.detail:
• Pacific Highway crossing (exit 275) is often shorter for cars than Peace Arch (exit 276)
• Passports for everyone, including the kids
• Have the Turo rental agreement and host's Canada OK on your phone
• Holiday week - 20-45 min wait budgeted

blocks.title: Drive border → downtown Vancouver
blocks.detail:
• ~33 mi on Highway 99 into downtown (signs in km)
• No winter-tire rule on this stretch

blocks.title: Park near Joe Fortes & walk in
blocks.detail:
• Street parking or a nearby parkade around Robson & Thurlow
• Keep luggage out of sight in the trunk

blocks.title: Lunch - Joe Fortes Seafood & Chop House
blocks.detail:
• Vancouver seafood institution since 1985
• Weekday lunch 11 AM-4 PM
• No kids' menu posted - ask about kids' portions
blocks.notes: Fish & Chips C$32 + Salmon Cakes C$36 (adults) + Chicken & Waffles C$29 + Fish & Chips C$32 (kids, no kids' menu) = C$129. Entrees only, water. + 5% GST (C$6.45) + 20% tip (C$25.80) = C$161.25, about US$116 at ~0.72. Prices from the May 2026 lunch menu; kids' portions, if offered, would lower this.

blocks.title: Back to the car & drive to the hotel
blocks.detail: • A few blocks to 655 Burrard St

blocks.title: Hyatt Regency Vancouver - valet, check in & relax
blocks.detail:
• Valet the car and luggage
• Early check-in requested (Globalist)
• Up to the room to unpack and rest
blocks.notes: Booked under Jennifer Borges: 25,000 points/night (Category 5) x 5 = 125,000 points, 2 adults + 2 children; checkout 12:00 PM. Globalist breakfast at Mosaic Grille covers the family. Cost shown is valet: C$52/night x 5 = C$260, about US$187 at ~0.72 - ask whether it's waived on award stays.
blocks.flag: Official check-in is 4:00 PM - early check-in requested but not guaranteed.

blocks.title: Walk to the Coal Harbour seawall
blocks.detail: • ~0.4 mi down Burrard St to the water

blocks.title: Coal Harbour seawall at sunset
blocks.detail:
• Sunset ~4:15 PM over the harbour
• Floatplanes landing and taking off, North Shore mountains
• Digital Orca sculpture and the Olympic Cauldron
• Vancouver Christmas Market (paid entry) is at Jack Poole Plaza - walk past

blocks.title: Canada Place promenade
blocks.detail:
• Harbour views under the white sails
• Part of the west promenade is under construction; no holiday display this year

blocks.title: Walk to Gastown
blocks.detail: • ~0.5 mi past Waterfront Station onto Water St

blocks.title: Gastown stroll
blocks.detail:
• Cobblestone Water St lit up after dark
• Gassy Jack statue in Maple Tree Square
• Stay on Water St and Maple Tree Square - avoid wandering south toward Hastings

blocks.title: Gastown Steam Clock
blocks.detail:
• Water St at Cambie
• Whistles every 15 min; the full show plays on the hour (6:00 PM)

blocks.title: Walk to The Old Spaghetti Factory
blocks.detail: • ~4 blocks east to 53 Water St

blocks.title: Dinner - The Old Spaghetti Factory, Gastown
blocks.detail:
• The chain's original Vancouver location, with a vintage streetcar inside
• Entrees include bread, green salad (or soup) and spumoni ice cream
• Kids' menu for ages 10 and under - drink and ice cream included
• Reservations recommended
blocks.notes: Lasagna C$21.25 + Chicken Parmigiana C$24.50 (adults) + Kids Spaghetti & Meatballs C$8.50 + Kids Chicken Tenders & Fries C$9.50 = C$63.75. Water for adults. + 5% GST (C$3.19) + 20% tip (C$12.75) = C$79.69, about US$57 at ~0.72. Prices from the Gastown menu, Oct 2026.

blocks.title: SkyTrain back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• Walk 5 min to Waterfront Station
• Expo Line 1 stop to Burrard Station (~2 min)
• Kids 12 and under ride free; tap a credit card to pay
• 2 blocks to the hotel

blocks.title: Wake up & get ready
blocks.detail: • Snow pants, boots, gloves on; pack dry layers for the car

blocks.title: Breakfast - Mosaic Grille (hotel)
blocks.detail:
• 2nd floor; buffet or a la carte
• Globalist breakfast covers 2 adults + 2 kids

blocks.title: Car from the valet
blocks.detail: • Call down for the car before leaving the room

blocks.title: Drive to Grouse Mountain
blocks.detail:
• ~8 mi over the Lions Gate Bridge to the base of Grouse
• Paid parking at the base lot

blocks.title: Tickets & Skyride up
blocks.detail:
• Red Skyride to the summit, ~8 min
• Family Mountain Admission (2 adults + 2 kids)
blocks.notes: Family Mountain Admission ticket C$229 (2 adults + 2 children 5-12), about US$165 at ~0.72. Grouse's posted 2026 rate; ticket is date-specific - buy online.

blocks.title: Peak of Christmas - snow play
blocks.detail:
• Mountaintop skating pond (skates C$10 adult / C$6 child)
• Sliding Zone (sled rental C$5)
• Sleigh ride through the snowy forest - needs a minimum snow base
• Santa's Workshop and Elf Headquarters crafts
• Peak of Christmas runs Nov 20-Dec 24, 2026 - today is the last day
• Christmas Eve hours may end early - check Today on Grouse that morning

blocks.title: Lunch - Lupins Cafe (Peak Chalet)
blocks.detail:
• Self-serve, main floor of the Peak Chalet
• Burgers, hot dogs, mac & cheese, chicken tenders
blocks.notes: Bacon Cheeseburger C$18 + Hot Honey Chicken Sandwich C$17 (adults) + Mac & Cheese C$12 + All Beef Canadian Hot Dog C$9 (kids) = C$56. Water. + 5% GST (C$2.80) = C$58.80, about US$42. Self-serve, no tip. Prices from Lupins' posted 2026 menu board; winter menu may differ slightly.

blocks.title: More snow time & summit views
blocks.detail:
• Back to the sliding lanes or the pond
• City and harbour views from the Peak Chalet decks

blocks.title: Change out of wet snow gear at the car
blocks.detail: • Dry socks and layers before the next stop

blocks.title: Drive to Capilano Suspension Bridge Park
blocks.detail: • ~2 mi down Capilano Rd

blocks.title: Capilano Suspension Bridge & Canyon Lights
blocks.detail:
• Cross the 450-ft suspension bridge, then Cliffwalk and Treetops Adventure in daylight
• Stay as Canyon Lights come on at dusk (~4:15 PM)
• Timed tickets - book the 2:00 PM hourly entry slot; children 0-5 free
• Canyon Lights runs Nov 20, 2026-Jan 3
blocks.notes: 2 adults x C$75 + 1 child (6-12) x C$28 + 1 child (5) free = C$178, about US$128 at ~0.72. Capilano's listed 2026 admission rates; holiday-week timed tickets can price higher, and tax may be added at checkout.

blocks.title: Drive back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• ~5 mi over the Lions Gate Bridge
• Valet the car

blocks.title: Quick hotel stop & walk to dinner
blocks.detail:
• Drop wet layers in the room
• ~8-min walk to 1121 Alberni St

blocks.title: Dinner - The Keg Steakhouse + Bar (Alberni)
blocks.detail:
• 1121 Alberni St
• Christmas Eve hours 2:00-9:00 PM (closed Christmas Day)
• Kids' menu - meals come with a side (vegetables, Caesar or fries)
• Reserve ahead (SevenRooms)
blocks.notes: Top Sirloin 8 oz C$43 + Blackened Chicken C$36 (adults) + Kids Sirloin 4 oz C$22 + Kids Chicken Strips C$16 = C$117. Water. + 5% GST (C$5.85) + 20% tip (C$23.40) = C$146.25, about US$105 at ~0.72. Prices from The Keg Alberni online menu, Oct 2026.

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail:
• Stockings out for Christmas morning
• Lights out by 9:00 PM keeps 10 hrs of sleep before a 7:00 AM wake-up

days.title: Christmas Day - Stanley Park & Robson Square

blocks.title: Christmas morning - presents in the room
blocks.detail: • Stockings and presents before breakfast

blocks.title: Breakfast - Mosaic Grille (hotel)
blocks.detail:
• 2nd floor; buffet or a la carte
• Globalist breakfast covers 2 adults + 2 kids
• Confirm Christmas morning hours at check-in

blocks.title: Get ready & car from the valet
blocks.detail: • Warm layers - the seawall is breezy

blocks.title: Drive to Stanley Park
blocks.detail:
• ~2 mi along West Georgia St
• Pay parking lots inside the park (PayByPhone)

blocks.title: Stanley Park - Prospect Point, totem poles & Lost Lagoon
blocks.detail:
• Drive the one-way Stanley Park Drive loop with stops
• Prospect Point lookout over the Lions Gate Bridge
• Brockton Point totem poles and a short seawall walk
• Lost Lagoon on the way out
• The park is always open; few facilities run on Christmas Day
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE: pay parking about C$10 for the visit, about US$7. Rates vary by lot and season.

blocks.title: Back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • Valet the car

blocks.title: Light lunch - in-room dining
blocks.detail:
• Most restaurants are closed Christmas Day
• Keep it light before the 4:30 PM buffet
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE - in-room dining menu and holiday hours not posted online. About C$80 for sandwiches and kids' items, about US$58.

blocks.title: Walk to Robson Square
blocks.detail: • ~5 min to 800 Robson St

blocks.title: Skating - Robson Square ice rink
blocks.detail:
• Free covered outdoor rink downtown
• Skate rentals C$5; helmets free and required for ages 12 and under
• Christmas Day hours were 11 AM-5 PM last season
blocks.notes: Skate rentals 4 x C$5 = C$20, about US$14. Hours from the 2025-26 season; confirm the 2026 schedule.

blocks.title: Christmas buffet - Mosaic Grille (hotel)
blocks.detail:
• Christmas Day buffet in the hotel - no driving
• Seatings were 4:30 PM and 7:00 PM in 2025 - book the 4:30
• Reserve as soon as it's announced
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE from 2025 pricing (C$60-125 per person): 2 adults x C$125 + 2 kids x C$60 = C$370 + 5% GST (C$18.50) + 18% gratuity (C$66.60) = C$455.10, about US$328. The 2026 menu and prices aren't posted yet.

blocks.title: Evening in the room
blocks.detail: • New toys and a movie

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail: • Lights out by 9:00 PM keeps 10 hrs of sleep before a 7:00 AM wake-up

blocks.title: Wake up & get ready
blocks.detail: • Snow pants, boots, gloves and binoculars; pack dry layers for the car

blocks.title: Breakfast - Mosaic Grille (hotel)
blocks.detail:
• 2nd floor; buffet or a la carte
• Globalist breakfast covers 2 adults + 2 kids

blocks.title: Car from the valet
blocks.detail: • Call down for the car before leaving the room

blocks.title: Drive the Sea-to-Sky Highway to Porteau Cove
blocks.detail:
• ~30 mi: Lions Gate Bridge, Horseshoe Bay, then Hwy 99 along Howe Sound
• Winter tires (M+S or snowflake) required north of Horseshoe Bay, Oct 1-Mar 31

blocks.title: Porteau Cove viewpoint
blocks.detail:
• Walk out on the pier for views across Howe Sound
• Quick stretch stop

blocks.title: Drive to Brackendale
blocks.detail: • ~20 mi north through Squamish

blocks.title: Bald eagles - Eagle Run dike
blocks.detail:
• Eagle Run Park on Government Rd; walk the dike along the Squamish River
• Peak eagle season is Dec-Jan; morning is a good viewing time
• Free; bring binoculars and stay on the dike

blocks.title: Drive to Shannon Falls
blocks.detail: • ~10 mi south on Hwy 99

blocks.title: Shannon Falls
blocks.detail:
• Easy 350 m trail to the base of the 335 m falls
• BC Parks day-use area, open in winter

blocks.title: Move to the gondola lot & park
blocks.detail:
• Next door to Shannon Falls
• Flat C$10 for the day - pay with the PayByPhone app
blocks.notes: Sea to Sky Gondola parking is a flat C$10/day year-round, about US$7 at ~0.72.

blocks.title: Sea to Sky Gondola up
blocks.detail:
• ~10 min ride to the Summit Lodge
• Family ticket online (2 adults + 2 kids)
blocks.notes: Family ticket C$165.95 online (2 adults + 2 child/youth), about US$119 at ~0.72; window price C$191.95, so buy online. Children 5 and under are free, but the family ticket is still cheaper than single tickets. Winter hours Nov 27-Dec 31: 9 AM-5 PM.

blocks.title: Lunch - Sky Pilot Smokehouse (Summit Lodge)
blocks.detail:
• Casual smokehouse with Howe Sound views
• BBQ sandwiches, bowls, salads; family-friendly options
• Open 11:00 AM-4:45 PM Oct 31-Dec 31
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE - no menu or prices posted online. About C$100 for 2 adult mains + 2 kids' items, water, with 5% GST, about US$72 at ~0.72. Kids' menu not confirmed.

blocks.title: Tube park
blocks.detail:
• 2-min walk from the Summit Lodge, next to the Wonderland Lake Loop
• C$5 each, unlimited slides; buy at Guest Services or the Summit Gift Shop
• Kids under 12 must be over 42 in (105 cm) and must be accompanied by an adult
blocks.notes: C$5 x 4 = C$20, about US$14 at ~0.72. Open Sun-Fri 9 AM-5 PM once snow conditions permit.
blocks.flag: Measure the 5-year-old before the trip - the tube park requires 42 in (105 cm).

blocks.title: Sky Pilot Suspension Bridge & Panorama Trail
blocks.detail:
• Cross the suspension bridge for views of the Chief and Howe Sound
• Short snowy loop on the Panorama Trail

blocks.title: Hot chocolate & sunset over Howe Sound
blocks.detail:
• Warm up in the Summit Lodge
• Sunset ~4:15 PM from the viewing platform

blocks.title: Drive to Rocky Mountain Flatbread (Main St)
blocks.detail:
• ~45 mi back down Hwy 99, through downtown to Main St
• Driving after dark - allow extra time
• Street parking on Main St

blocks.title: Dinner - Rocky Mountain Flatbread
blocks.detail:
• 4186 Main St; wood-fired flatbread pizzas
• Kids' menu and a kids' play kitchen area
• Open Sat 11 AM-10 PM - reserve ahead
blocks.notes: Pesto Chicken flatbread 10-in C$24.85 + Apple Rosemary Bacon flatbread C$24.85 (adults) + Kids Mozza Pizza C$11.95 + Kids Mozza Pizza C$11.95 = C$73.60. Water. + 5% GST (C$3.68) + 20% tip (C$14.72) = C$92.00, about US$66 at ~0.72. Prices from the Vancouver menu, Jun 2026.

blocks.title: Drive back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• ~4 mi to the Hyatt Regency
• Valet the car

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail: • Back before 8:00 PM keeps 10 hrs of sleep before a 7:00 AM wake-up

blocks.title: Breakfast - Mosaic Grille (hotel)
blocks.detail: • Globalist breakfast covers 2 adults + 2 kids

blocks.title: Walk to the Hornby St ferry dock
blocks.detail: • ~0.7 mi down to False Creek, by the Burrard Bridge

blocks.title: Mini-ferry to Granville Island
blocks.detail:
• Aquabus or False Creek Ferries, about 5 min across
• Pay on board
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE: about C$20 round trip for the family, about US$14. Check current fares.

blocks.title: Granville Island Public Market & Kids Market
blocks.detail:
• Public Market open 9 AM-6 PM - bakeries, fudge, fresh donuts
• Kids Market: 25 kid-focused shops and activities in an old factory and a train caboose
• Railspur Alley and the waterfront boardwalk
• Confirm Kids Market holiday hours

blocks.title: Lunch - Granville Island Public Market food vendors
blocks.detail:
• Everyone picks their own: pot pies, chowder, pizza, sandwiches
• Waterfront seating if it's dry
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE: about C$60 for 4 casual counter meals with water, no tip, about US$43.

blocks.title: Downtime at the hotel
blocks.detail: • Rest before the evening lights

blocks.title: Drive to VanDusen Botanical Garden
blocks.detail:
• ~5 mi south to 5251 Oak St
• On-site parking lot

blocks.title: VanDusen Festival of Lights
blocks.detail:
• Over a million lights across the 55-acre garden
• Timed entry - book a 4:15-4:30 PM slot
• Open nightly Nov 27-Jan 3 (closed Dec 25), 4-10 PM
blocks.notes: 2 adults x C$29 + 2 children (5-12) x C$12 = C$82 + 5% GST (C$4.10) = C$86.10, about US$62. Published 2026 prices; tickets go on sale Nov 4, 2026.

blocks.title: Drive to Olympic Village
blocks.detail: • ~4 mi to 1 Athletes Way on False Creek

blocks.title: Dinner - Tap & Barrel Olympic Village
blocks.detail:
• On the False Creek seawall with skyline views
• Kids' menu (12 & under) includes a drink and gelato
• Reserve ahead
blocks.notes: ESTIMATE from the Tap & Barrel Shipyards menu (Sep 2026), same chain: Fish & Chips C$24 + Pesto Linguine C$26 + Kids Chicken Strips C$13 + Kids Fish & Chips C$13 = C$76 + 5% GST + 20% tip = C$95, about US$68. The Olympic Village menu may differ slightly.

blocks.title: Drive back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• ~2 mi
• Valet the car

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
